notes: Stored lesson records are compact local curriculum blueprints; LessonPage expands them into structured long-form study material locally from the course/module/coverage metadata.
One canonical acadassist.courseProgress state now stores lesson completion, quiz completion, quiz results, last lesson and last activity.
Dashboard, Courses, CourseDetail, Progress and Subjects synchronization use the shared courseProgress calculation helper.
Legacy acadassist.courseQuizResults is migrated into the canonical courseProgress record on first load.
